summary: Supplements RFC 3279 with encoding formats, identifiers and parameter formats for the GOST R 34.10-94, GOST R 34.10-2001 and GOST R 34.11-94 algorithms in X.509 certificates and CRLs. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Tells certificate makers how to write down the details of the GOST signing methods on a digital ID card.
